Faster product selection

Four details narrow the range quickly

  1. LoadMaximum weight and load center
  2. LiftFloor movement or required lift height
  3. RouteAisle, turning radius, floor, and gradient
  4. DutyTravel distance, shift length, and charging plan

Buyer questions

Direct answers before inquiry

Which machine is used only to move pallets horizontally?

Choose a manual or electric pallet truck. Select by load capacity, route length, floor condition, and operator mode.

When should I choose a pallet stacker?

Choose a pallet stacker when pallets must be raised into racking or positioned above floor level. Confirm pallet entry, load center, lift height, and residual capacity.

What information is needed for a forklift quotation?

Provide the maximum load, load dimensions, lift height, aisle width, floor or outdoor conditions, daily working hours, battery preference, and destination market.

Need a model shortlist?

Send the load, lift height, aisle, route, and daily duty.
